text: {"lessons":["Selling some shares after gains felt satisfying, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; consider each stock’s prospects and my overall plan.","I should avoid letting the pain of selling at a loss keep me from making a rational decision when a holding’s outlook changes.","With only a few periods of mixed account returns and little trading, I should stay patient and make deliberate decisions rather than overreact to short-term moves."]}
